用户名不能以连字符开头: Username cannot start with a hyphen

组网访问设置无效，访问保持关闭: Invalid mesh access settings; access remains blocked
组网访问设置无法读取: Unable to read mesh access settings

请先连接组网并明确授权本机服务端口: Connect to the mesh and authorize local service ports first
请清除环境变量 %s 后连接内置组网: Clear environment variable %s before connecting the built-in mesh
请输入明确端口，例如 22/tcp, 3389/tcp；不支持端口范围: Enter individual ports, such as 22/tcp, 3389/tcp; ranges are unsupported
请选择有效的直连、拦截或代理组策略: Choose a valid Direct, Reject or proxy group policy
远程桌面使用本机连接文件打开: Remote Desktop opens with a local connection file
连接 Tailscale 超时，请检查网络或代理设置后重试: Tailscale connection timed out. Check network or proxy settings and try again
连接方式不是远程桌面: Connection method is not Remote Desktop
在其他应用中显示窗口、切换代理与路由模式: Show the window and change proxy or routing mode from any app
快捷键无法启用，请检查组合是否被占用：%w: Could not enable shortcuts. Check whether the keys are in use: %w
快捷键无法启用，请检查组合是否被占用：Ctrl+Alt+P: Could not enable shortcut. Check whether Ctrl+Alt+P is in use.
网络服务暂不可用，请稍后重试: Network service is unavailable. Try again shortly.
此系统暂不支持系统代理: System proxy is unavailable on this platform.
请先在概览中安装或修复 TUN 服务: Install or repair the TUN service in Overview first.
在其他应用中也可使用；留空即关闭。关闭 Gopurr 后释放。: Works from any app. Leave blank to disable. Keys are released when Gopurr quits.
输入组合，如 Ctrl+Alt+P 或 CmdOrCtrl+Shift+Spac: Enter a combination such as Ctrl+Alt+P or CmdOrCtrl+Shift+Space. Use letters, numbers, F1–F12 or Space. On Mac, Cmd and Option are supported.
已有未完成的订阅操作，请完成或清空后重新打开导入链接: A subscription edit is unfinished. Complete or clear it, then open the import link again.
已收到订阅链接，请确认来源后点击添加: Subscription link received. Check the source, then click Add.
导入链接无效，请使用包含 HTTP 或 HTTPS 订阅地址的 install-: Invalid import link. Use an install-config link containing an HTTP or HTTPS subscription URL.
快捷键不能包含换行或制表符: Shortcuts cannot contain line breaks or tabs
请使用 Ctrl、Alt、Shift 或 Cmd 组合: Use Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Cmd as modifiers
至少包含 Ctrl、Alt 或 Cmd 中的一个修饰键: Include at least one of Ctrl, Alt or Cmd
按键须为字母、数字、F1–F12 或 Space: Use a letter, number, F1–F12 or Space
同一组合不能用于多个动作: The same shortcut cannot be assigned to multiple actions
来源已更新；聚合配置 %s 保留原版本：%w: Source updated; aggregate %s kept its previous version: %w
来源更新后自动重新聚合: Rebuilt when a source is updated
聚合配置缺少来源设置: The aggregate profile has no source settings
聚合配置的来源不存在或引用了另一个聚合: Aggregate sources are missing or reference another aggregate
覆写库最多保存 128 个模板: The library can contain up to 128 templates
覆写模板 ID 无效或重复: An override template ID is invalid or duplicated
模板名称须为 1–128 个字符，不能包含换行: Template names must contain 1–128 characters without line breaks
单个覆写模板不能超过 256 KiB，模板库总计不能超过 4 MiB: Each template is limited to 256 KiB and the library to 4 MiB
所选覆写模板已不存在，请重新选择: A selected template no longer exists. Select it again.
同一作用范围不能重复应用同一个覆写模板: A template cannot be applied twice in the same scope
此模板仍被全局或订阅使用，请先在对应作用范围移除并保存应用顺序: This template is still in use. Remove it from the relevant scope and save its application order first.
模板修改会使订阅 %q 无法使用：%w: This template change would invalidate profile %q: %w
请先保存模板库，再保存应用顺序: Save the template library before saving the application order
把常用 YAML 保存为模板，在全局或多个订阅中重复应用。模板按 ID 引用，改: Save reusable YAML templates and apply them globally or to multiple profiles. Renaming a template keeps its existing links.
新建模板或从本地 YAML 文件导入，保存后可在「应用顺序」中启用。: Create a template or import a local YAML file. Save it, then enable it under Application order.
映射递归合并，数组整体替换。端口、TUN 和控制接口仍由 Gopurr 管理；模: Maps merge recursively and lists replace existing lists. Gopurr manages ports, TUN and controller interfaces. Template files may contain credentials; store them securely.
从上到下依次应用，后面的模板覆盖前面的字段；当前范围内的手写 YAML 最后应用: Templates apply from top to bottom; later templates override earlier fields. Inline YAML for this scope applies last. Removing a template here disables it without deleting it.
没有可添加的已保存模板: No saved templates available to add
此范围尚未应用模板。添加后保存即可启用。: No templates are applied to this scope. Add one and save to enable it.
模板库有未保存的修改，请先返回「模板库」保存。: The library has unsaved changes. Return to Template library and save first.
已导入到草稿，保存模板库后才会生效: Imported into the draft. Save the library to make it available.
模板可能包含凭据，请妥善保存。: Templates may contain credentials. Store them securely.
聚合订阅不存在，请重新选择: The aggregate profile no longer exists. Select it again.
聚合已保存，共 %d 个节点；来源配置保持不变: Aggregate saved with %d nodes. Source profiles are unchanged.
合并已导入配置中的节点，生成独立配置。保留原来源，不继承其规则、DNS 或策略组: Combine imported nodes into a separate profile. Source rules, DNS and proxy groups are not inherited.
合并连接参数相同的重复节点: Merge nodes with identical connection settings
筛选匹配来源中的原始节点名。去重保留顺序靠前的节点与名称；链式代理节点保持独立。: Filters match original source names. Deduplication keeps the first node and its name; nodes with a proxy chain stay separate.
点击“预览聚合”检查筛选结果与最终节点顺序。: Click Preview aggregate to check the filtered nodes and final order.
仅支持直接列出 proxies 的配置，代理集合暂不支持。先更新来源订阅，聚合会: Sources must list proxies directly; proxy providers are not supported yet. Update source subscriptions to refresh aggregates. Rebuild reads local caches only.
请先导入至少一个包含节点的订阅或本地配置。: Import a subscription or local profile containing nodes first.
请至少选择一个聚合来源: Select at least one aggregate source
聚合来源不能超过 64 个: An aggregate cannot contain more than 64 sources
聚合来源为空或重复: Aggregate sources are empty or repeated
来源前缀不能包含换行，且不能超过 256 字节: Source prefixes cannot contain line breaks or exceed 256 bytes
聚合来源已不存在，请重新选择: An aggregate source no longer exists. Select sources again.
聚合订阅不能作为另一个聚合的来源: An aggregate cannot be used as another aggregate source
来源 %q 含有代理集合；当前聚合仅支持直接列出 proxies 节点的配置: Source %q contains proxy providers. Aggregation currently requires nodes listed directly in proxies.
来源 %q 没有可聚合的 proxies 节点: Source %q has no proxies nodes to aggregate
来源 %q 中的节点必须为 YAML 映射: Nodes in source %q must be YAML mappings
来源 %q 中的节点名称或类型为空，或名称重复: Source %q has an empty node name or type, or duplicate names
聚合结果不能超过 20000 个节点: An aggregate cannot contain more than 20000 nodes
来源 %q 中的节点字段无法序列化: Node fields in source %q cannot be serialized
筛选后没有节点，请调整聚合来源或筛选条件: No nodes remain after filtering. Adjust the sources or filters.
来源 %q 的节点 %q 的 dialer-proxy 必须为非空字符串: Source %q node %q must have a nonempty string for dialer-proxy
来源 %q 的节点 %q 依赖未包含的节点或策略组 %q: Source %q node %q depends on missing node or group %q
配置必须为单个 YAML 映射: The configuration must be a single YAML mapping
聚合节点 %q 的链式代理存在循环: Aggregate node %q has a circular proxy chain
聚合来源已变化，请重新预览后保存: Aggregate sources changed. Preview again before saving.
配置仍被聚合订阅 %q 使用，请先修改或删除该聚合: This profile is used by aggregate %q. Edit or remove that aggregate first.
节点端口须为 1–65535: Node port must be between 1 and 65535
修改仅保存在当前订阅的本地覆写中，订阅更新后继续生效。未修改字段沿用最新订阅。: Changes apply to this profile through local overrides and survive updates. Untouched fields follow the latest subscription.
当前配置没有内联节点，可编辑策略组；代理集合中的节点由订阅提供方管理。: This profile has no inline nodes. You can edit groups; provider nodes are managed by their source.
订阅已移除此项；请点击恢复所选项以移除失效的本地修改。: The subscription removed this item. Reset the selected item to clear its obsolete local changes.
协议、密码与其他高级参数保持订阅原值；不提供地址或端口的节点只支持改名。: Protocol, credentials and advanced fields follow the subscription. Nodes without an address or port support renaming only.
暂无策略组，点击添加策略组开始。: No groups yet. Add a group to get started.
此策略组将在保存时删除。仍被其他策略组或规则使用时，保存会提示修正。: This group will be deleted when saved. Update any groups or rules that still reference it first.
尚未添加成员；使用代理集合的原策略组仍保留其集合配置。: No members added. Existing provider settings are preserved.
原节点 %q 已不存在，请移除其本地修改后重试: Original node %q no longer exists. Reset its local changes and retry.
名称不能为空、内置策略名或包含逗号和换行: Names cannot be empty, use a built-in policy name, or contain commas or line breaks
服务器地址不能为空或包含空白: Server address cannot be empty or contain whitespace
新增策略组不能标记为删除: A new group cannot be marked for deletion
原策略组 %q 已不存在，请移除其本地修改后重试: Original group %q no longer exists. Reset its local changes and retry.
请选择手动、自动测速、故障转移或负载均衡策略: Choose select, url-test, fallback or load-balance
节点或策略组名称 %q 重复: Node or group name %q is duplicated
策略组 %q 仍被 %q 使用，请先修改成员: Group %q is still used by %q. Update its members first.
策略组 %q 至少需要一个成员: Group %q needs at least one member
策略组 %q 仍被规则使用，请先修改规则: Group %q is still used by a rule. Update that rule first.
历史名称映射过多或不属于原有节点，请恢复所选项后重试: Too many historical names or history belongs to no source item. Reset the selected item and retry.
历史名称映射无效或重复，请恢复所选项后重试: Historical names are invalid or duplicated. Reset the selected item and retry.
历史名称 %q 与当前节点或策略组冲突，请恢复所选项后重试: Historical name %q conflicts with a current node or group. Reset the selected item and retry.
历史名称 %q 与其他本地修改冲突，请恢复所选项后重试: Historical name %q conflicts with another local edit. Reset the selected item and retry.
策略组 %q 仍被 dialer-proxy 使用，请先修改链式代理: Group %q is still used by dialer-proxy. Update that outbound chain first.
策略组 %q 仍被入站或端口转发使用，请先修改对应出口: Group %q is still used by an inbound listener or port forward. Update its outbound policy first.
